verdict.rationale: PostHog's Data Warehouse feature explicitly syncs external sources (Stripe, Postgres, Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) and lets developers query them alongside PostHog events/persons/sessions in one SQL query, avoiding custom ETL; the CDP also supports sending/exporting event data out to destinations in realtime or on schedule. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of warehouse sync reliability or export completeness, and no explicit mention of bidirectional continuous export of PostHog events into a customer's own warehouse (only inbound sync + in-product query is well documented).
